Why Pikabora

Built for how you actually eat

Grounded in real Kenyan food data

Every suggestion is matched against the Kenya Food Composition Tables, not generic nutrition advice written for another country.

UgaliBeansSukuma wikiEggsSweet potatoOmenaAvocadoGreen grams

Works within your budget

Pikabora never assumes you can buy eggs, meat, or milk on demand. If it's not already in your kitchen, it's not the answer.

Knows its limits

Pikabora teaches nutrition — it doesn't diagnose. If something you describe needs a clinic, we'll tell you to go, every time.

Learns as you go

Pikabora pays attention to what you actually cook, skip, or can't get — not just what you say you'd like — and adjusts its suggestions from there.

Built for Pregnant women Caregivers Children 6–23 months Health & nutrition partners

Pikabora provides nutrition education based on the Kenya Food Composition Tables. It does not diagnose or replace antenatal care. If you notice bleeding, severe fatigue, or swelling, contact a clinic or community health worker right away.
